description: VIC-Res simulations cover daily Mekong discharge and hydropower during 1996 to 2016 under 32 scenarios. PowNet input and output files address Cambodia, Laos and Thailand for three selected scenarios. This resource is provided by Stefano Galelli; Thanh Duc Dang; Ng Jia Yi and coauthors. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These linked water-energy scenarios are research simulations, not observed plant dispatch. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
